title: Online Draft Co-Training for Speculative Decoding in Large-Scale, Long-Context RL Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.07108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates rollout generation, which dominates the cost of reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. Online co-training can further increase the draft's accuracy, yielding greater speedups. However, scaling this approach to co-training on large models with long contexts poses two obstacles: (1) branch attention is unsupported by standard causal context-parallel (CP) implementations, and (2) target features span across pipeline-parallel (PP) stages. We address both with an end-to-end system for large-scale online draft co-training. For CP, we extend packed, load-balanced zigzag ring attention by merging rank-local branch attention with causal main-sequence attention. For PP, TapChannel transports intermediate target features across stages via a separate path, leaving the pipeline schedule unaffected. Experiments demonstrate that co-trained drafts closely track the policy baseline while delivering substantial rollout

translated_title: 面向大规模长上下文强化学习后训练中投机解码的在线草稿模型协同训练
translated_abstract: 投机解码可以加速rollout生成，而rollout生成在强化学习（RL）后训练的成本中占据主导地位。在线协同训练可以进一步提高草稿模型的准确率，从而获得更大的加速效果。然而，将该方法扩展到长上下文大模型的协同训练面临两个障碍：（1）标准的因果上下文并行（CP）实现不支持分支注意力；（2）目标模型的特征跨越流水线并行（PP）的各个阶段。我们通过一个面向大规模在线草稿协同训练的端到端系统来解决这两个问题。对于CP，我们将rank局部的分支注意力与因果主序列注意力相融合，扩展了打包且负载均衡的锯齿形环形注意力。对于PP，TapChannel通过独立路径跨阶段传输中间目标特征，且不影响流水线调度。实验表明，协同训练的草稿模型能紧密跟随策略基线，同时带来显著的rollout加速。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个端到端系统，通过在上下文并行中融合分支注意力与主序列注意力、并引入TapChannel独立通道跨流水线阶段传输目标特征，实现了大规模长上下文强化学习后训练中投机解码草稿模型的在线协同训练，从而显著加速rollout生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end system for online draft co-training in large-scale, long-context RL post-training, which merges branch attention with causal main-sequence attention in context parallelism and introduces TapChannel to transport target features across pipeline stages, enabling significant rollout generation speedup.
